01 — Brand Foundation

Colors

These are the only colors used across all Symmetrik MD content — thumbnails, stories, carrossels, static posts. Do not introduce colors outside this palette.

Red
#CC380D
Primary accent. CTAs, highlights, overlays.
Black
#000000
Main background. Default for all dark content.
Light Grey
#EAEAEA
Body text. Secondary backgrounds.
Blue
#193981
Supporting. Use sparingly.
Gold
#AF832B
Premium feel. Special posts only.
Light Blue
#ADCFFB
Soft contrast. Backgrounds only.
Dark Green
#00331C
Supporting dark tone. Backgrounds only.
✓ Do
  • Use Red on dark backgrounds for maximum impact
  • White or Light Grey text on Black or Dark Green backgrounds
  • Red for titles, tags, and key text overlays on video
  • Black background as the default when in doubt
  • Gold only for premium or milestone content
✗ Don't
  • White text on Light Blue backgrounds (low contrast)
  • Red text on Grey (doesn't meet readability standards)
  • Mix more than 3 colors in one post
  • Use colors outside this palette — ever
  • Place Black text on Dark Green (unreadable at small sizes)
02 — Brand Foundation

Typography

Three type styles define Symmetrik MD. Each has a specific role — don't swap them around. When working in Canva, use the closest available alternative shown below.

HEADLINES
Role
Do Hyeon / Heavy Sans
All caps. Main post titles, hero text, large overlays. Bold, wide, commanding. Canva alternative: Raleway ExtraBold or Bebas Neue.
MONO / TAGS
Role
Red Hat Mono / Monospace
Tag bars, labels, captions, metadata. Always uppercase + letter-spacing. Technical, precise. Canva alternative: Space Mono or Courier Prime.
Script overlay
Role
Cursive Script
Script overlays only — the italic handwritten text seen on thumbnails. Always in Red. Never use for body text or captions. Canva alternative: Sacramento or Great Vibes.
03 — Brand Foundation

Tone of Voice

Symmetrik MD speaks with authority and warmth — never hype, never vague. Think: board-certified physician who also genuinely cares about each patient.

Clinical
Use correct anatomical and medical terms. Precision builds trust. Never dumb it down — educate instead.
"superficial temporal artery" not "a blood vessel near the temple"
Confident
No hedging language. Dr. Fernandez knows his craft — the copy should reflect that without arrogance.
"we identified" not "we tried to find" or "we think we noticed"
Educational
Every reel teaches something. The audience should leave knowing more than when they arrived.
"Here's what this finding means and how it changed the plan…"
Human
Behind every procedure is a real patient. Acknowledge that — especially in patient story content.
"a confident, radiant patient thrilled to see her reflection again"
04 — Content Structure

Content Types

Four formats make up the Symmetrik MD content mix. Each has its own purpose — knowing which is which tells you how to approach it.

Active Now

Reels

The main educational engine. Short-form video with a branded thumbnail as cover. Always paired with a caption and a full video copy.

  • Always upload thumb as Reel cover — never a video frame
  • Caption goes in the post field, copy is for the video
  • Check tag bar matches the series (e.g. Academy · 001)
Coming Soon

Stories

Daily touchpoints. Quick, ephemeral, brand-consistent. Will follow a color rotation system with defined templates.

  • Templates + color rotation rules coming in next update
  • Never create ad-hoc stories outside approved templates
  • Flag anything urgent to the team before posting
In Planning

Carrossel

Deep-dive educational content. Multi-slide format with a strong first slide that acts as the hook. Follows brand color palette strictly.

  • First slide = the hook (treat it like a thumbnail)
  • Consistent typography across all slides
  • Each slide should be readable as a standalone image
In Planning

Static

Single-image posts. Used for announcements, quotes, procedural highlights, and feed aesthetics between video content.

  • Must carry logo — bottom center or top right
  • Keep text minimal — one message per image
  • Background must come from the approved color palette
05 — Daily Operations

Before You Hit Post

Run through this every time — for every post, regardless of content type. It takes 2 minutes and prevents 90% of mistakes.

A — Reels Checklist

Thumbnail uploaded as the cover — not a frame from the video
Caption copied from the guide into the Instagram caption field exactly as written
Emojis and line breaks are preserved — don't paste into plain text
Dr. Cesar's name spelled correctly (Dr. Cesar Fernandez MD)
No content marked [pending] — check guide notes before posting
Video file matches the thumbnail topic — double-check before upload

B — Any Post Checklist

Colors used are from the approved palette only
Logo is present if it's a static image or branded asset
Copy was not edited — if something feels off, flag it first
Post timing aligns with the weekly content calendar
Nothing marked as pending or "to be confirmed" in the guide
When in doubt — ask. Never guess on brand content.

Illustration Editorias — When & How to Use
Facial Harmonization
Discovery Consultation · Full Facial Harmonization

Use on days when these procedures are scheduled, or to build anticipation for the Consultation. The 4 variants let you rotate without repeating — pick one per week cycle.

Ultrasound
Masseter Neurotoxin ft. Ultrasound · Educational

Use when posting Ultrasound-related Reels, on Masseter procedure days, or for educational story sequences. The blue palette differentiates clearly from the daily diary templates.

Academy
Course Announcements · Training Content · Promo

Reserved exclusively for Academy content — courses, announcements, limited seats, and training highlights. Do not use for clinical procedures.

Every Face Tells a Story
Patient Stories · Before & After · Emotional Content

Use for patient story content, results context, or when the narrative is more emotional and personal. Pairs well with the Patient Story Reels already in the batch.

Map — Miami
Pontual · Location · Find Us

Use only for location-related content — directions, "find us", clinic address announcements, or event invites. Not for daily use.

Font Rules — Text Added in App

Instagram native: Use the Typewriter font. Instagram Edits: Use Karben 105 Mono. These are the closest matches to the Symmetrik MD brand typography available natively — no external app or Canva needed. The example text shown on the templates is reference only.

Main Title
Before the Injection
Script Overlay
Medicine and Safety First
Caption
Ultrasound Guided Temple Filler
Copy — Video
Treating the temples requires careful planning especially when vascular anatomy is highly active.

In this case, our Board-Certified Aesthetic Physician and Lead Injector, Dr. Cesar Fernandez MD, identified a prominent, highly pulsatile active superficial temporal artery within the planned treatment plane using Facial Ultrasound before injecting.

Although Temple Filler is commonly performed using a cannula technique, ultrasound revealed that this patient's vascular anatomy required an adjusted approach. Treatment was performed conservatively and under real-time ultrasound guidance.

Medicine and safety first. Always at Symmetrik MD.
